description: When the decision was accepted in R/app_tsm_review.R (system time, no fixed timezone recorded)
hydraulics or uptake -- which fitting stage this row's Accept click was for
NH4-N or SRP; NA for a hydraulics-stage row (hydraulics is fit once per event
conc_corr_ugL or conc_corr_coprec_ugL; NA for a hydraulics-stage row
logger or probe_grab -- which conservative-tracer series the accepted hydraulics fit used (uptake-stage rows carry the source of the hydraulics they depend on, for traceability)
time_since_release_s values (semicolon-separated) manually excluded before this fit, e.g. a field/lab error identified during review. Empty = no exclusions
Finite-volume spatial resolution used for this accepted fit
Number of global Latin Hypercube Sample draws used for this accepted fit
Accepted (hydraulics stage) or inherited (uptake stage) Stage-1 dispersion coefficient
Accepted Stage-2 main-channel uptake coefficient; NA for a hydraulics-stage row
Accepted Stage-2 storage-zone uptake coefficient; NA for a hydraulics-stage row
Fit RMSE (sqrt-transformed concentration scale) at accept time -- comparable only to another row fit on the exact same observed series; see the RMSE note in dict_tsm_uptake_summary.csv
Synthetic pre-arrival background points added before fitting (0 if the gap-fill checkbox was off or there was no gap to fill)
Sampling interval used for that gap fill; NA when n_gap_filled is 0
Free-text; currently always "accepted via app_tsm_review" -- edit this file directly to add a specific reason for a given decision if useful for a collaborator picking this up later
